lessons.title: Blink an LED
lessons.objective: Set pin 13 as an output and blink an LED on a 500ms cycle.
steps: Place the LED on the breadboard — long leg (anode) toward the signal side.
Add the 220Ω resistor in series with the LED.
Wire pin 13 to the resistor, and the LED cathode to GND.
In setup(), tell the Arduino pin 13 is an OUTPUT: pinMode(13, OUTPUT);
In loop(), turn it on, wait, turn it off, wait.

lessons.title: Analog Input — Potentiometer
lessons.objective: Read a potentiometer, map its value, and print it to the serial monitor.
steps: Wire the potentiometer's outer pins to 5V and GND.
Wire the middle pin (wiper) to analog pin A0.
In setup(), start the serial monitor: Serial.begin(9600);
In loop(), read A0 with analogRead(A0) — you'll get 0–1023.
Map the value and print it with Serial.println().
